title: Six Flags Entertainment Corporation/NEW 8-K Filing — 2026-04-06
summary: Six Flags Entertainment Corporation filed an 8-K on April 6, 2026, announcing the completion of the sale of six theme parks (Worlds of Fun, Michigan's Adventure, Valleyfair, Six Flags Great Escape, Schlitterbahn Waterpark Galveston, and Six Flags St. Louis) to EPR Properties and EP OPCO WOFR, LLC. The transaction was governed by an Equity Purchase Agreement dated March 5, 2026.
key_points: Six Flags completed the sale of six parks to EPR Properties on April 6, 2026.
Parks sold include Worlds of Fun (Kansas City), Michigan's Adventure, Valleyfair (Minnesota), Six Flags Great Escape (New York), Schlitterbahn Waterpark Galveston (Texas), and Six Flags St. Louis.
The Equity Purchase Agreement was originally announced on March 5, 2026.
Buyer is EPR Properties, a Maryland real estate investment trust; operator is EP OPCO WOFR, LLC.
The filing is categorized under Item 7.01 (Regulation FD Disclosure) and Item 8.01 (Other Events).
why_it_matters: This is a corporate M&A transaction disclosure for a single company (Six Flags). It has no relevance to broad market structure or macro catalysts that would affect financial markets generally. The filing is relevant only to Six Flags (ticker: FUN) shareholders and EPR Properties investors.
